description: This Java class 'EntityWhereString' represents a raw SQL string condition used within the Apache OFBiz entity framework. It encapsulates SQL expressions for WHERE clause snippets, allowing minimal and unsafe direct SQL embedding, primarily for internal or advanced use cases.

classes.name: EntityWhereString
classes.description: A final class implementing EntityCondition that encapsulates a raw SQL string for use as a condition in entity queries.

methods.name: EntityWhereString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a raw SQL string.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the SQL string is empty or null.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Returns the embedded SQL string as the WHERE clause snippet.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Performs validation on the model entity; here it does nothing and assumes always valid.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Unsupported operation; throws exception as SQL evaluation isn't possible in this context.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Unsupported operation; throws exception as SQL evaluation isn't possible in this context.

methods.name: getWhereString
methods.description: Returns the raw SQL string embedded in this condition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing EntityConditionVisitor and calls its visit method.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the SQL string content.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the SQL string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the object, which is the SQL string.
